display.title: Yud-Tes Shevat: The Shpoler Zeide's Family Day
display.summary_short: Who was the Shpoler Zeide, and why his grandchildren gather every 19th of Shevat to retell his stories and sing his famous nigun.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains the word Zeide, grandfather, and introduces a very special Zeide: the great tzaddik Rabbi Aryeh Leib, known to all as the Shpoler Zeide. The 19th of Shevat is a special day for his descendants, who gather for family reunions to retell the stories about him and learn the living lessons in them. At these gatherings they take on resolutions to learn more Torah and do more mitzvos, and they sing his famous lively nigun, Hop Kozak.
display.lesson: Stories of tzaddikim are living lessons that guide us to grow in Torah and mitzvos.
